items.text: NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING REGARDING THE VACATION OF DRAINAGE AND UTILITY EASEMENT On October 12, 2026, at 10:00 A.M., the Johnson County Board of Commissioners will hold a public hearing regarding Ordinance 2026-O-10: An Ordinance Vacating a Drainage and Utility Easement. The Commissioners will consider the vacation of a drainage and utility easement contained within Lots 36 and 37 in the Final Plat of Water’s Edge, Section Three, an addition in Johnson County, as per the plat thereof recorded in Instrument 2025-010117, in the of ice of the Recorder of Johnson County, Indiana. This addition is north of the intersection of Lakeview Dr and Waters Edge Way. The hearing will be held at the West Annex Auditorium, 86 West Court Street, Franklin, IN 46131. Water Main Flushing
The Edinburgh Municipal Utilities will be flushing water mains beginning October 5 th at 7:30AM and continue through October 16 th . Customers may experience some discoloration in their water during this operation. If this occurs at your residence or business, we suggest that you run a slow stream of cold water until the discoloration disappears. Usually, five to ten minutes will take care of the problem. If the discoloration persists, please contact the Utility Office at 812-526-3514 option 5. We strongly suggest that white clothing not be washed during the daytime hours to help reduce the risk of staining. Some other light colors could also be affected. To be safe these colors should be washed after the hour of 7:00PM until after the flushing program is completed.
